changes.title: South China evacuates over 340,000 and cancels flights as region braces for Typhoon Noul
changes.summary: Typhoon Noul is battering southern China and Hong Kong with winds and heavy rain.

changes.title: China Has Come Through Trump’s Trade War in a Good Position
changes.summary: Despite threats from President Trump, the overall average weighted tariff on Chinese goods remained about the same, and is now lower than countries like Brazil and Canada.

changes.title: New U.S. tariffs linked to claims of foreign forced labor dismay and anger trading partners
changes.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump's latest set of tariffs drew objections Friday from America's trading partners including China and Japan, with Australia's trade minister slamming them as "completely unjustified.".

changes.title: In a first, Chinese woman wins the prestigious Fields Medal
changes.summary: Despite criticisms of a brain drain from China to the U.S., the awards come at a time when several high-profile Chinese scholars have returned home, some citing an increasingly hostile academic environment in America.

changes.title: Rubio and Chinese Diplomat Make Plans for Trump and Xi’s Washington Summit
changes.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio spent much of a meeting with China’s foreign minister discussing the summit, but did not bring up President Trump’s claims of election interference by China.
